title: CNMD - VehicleTrip schema
description: Schema for a journey made using a soft-mobility vehicle.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be VehicleTrip.

arrivalTime.description: Property. Date and time when the trip ended, in ISO 8601 format.

destination.description: Relationship. Reference to the destination DockingStation.

departureTime.description: Property. Date and time when the trip started, in ISO 8601 format.

distance.description: Property. Distance travelled, normally expressed in metres.

duration.description: Property. Duration of the trip, normally expressed in seconds.

origin.description: Relationship. Reference to the origin DockingStation.

status.description: Property. Current status of the trip.

refVehicle.description: Relationship. Reference to the Vehicle used for the trip.
